dedupe_keys.name: floodnet input data road networks elevation and flood inundation for metro manila cebu and davao

description: This bundle holds every raw input for FloodNet, a percolation-based study of urban road network resilience to flood-induced degradation in three Philippine metropolitan areas: Metro Manila, Metro Cebu and Metro Davao. It contains a Geofabrik OpenStreetMap snapshot of the Philippines (27 March 2026) and enriched GeoPackages of drivable road edges per metro with length, base speed, node elevation and flood-eligibility flags per return period; SRTM 30 m elevation rasters clipped to the metros; Project NOAH flood hazard polygons (low, medium and high hazard from Flo-2D simulations) for 5-, 25- and 100-year return periods; and administrative boundaries for the 17, 13 and 10 local government units studied. Each folder has a metadata file on provenance, schema and known issues. It was published by Rixdon Niño Mape (version 1.0.0 of 18 April 2026), with the analysis code on GitHub. Coverage is city to metropolitan scale. The 1.3 GB zip is free on Zenodo; the record states no single licence, and the sources carry ODbL-1.0 (OpenStreetMap, Project NOAH) or public domain (SRTM) terms. Caveats: flood polygons contain invalid geometries, and four Davao units are excluded for missing hazard data. The data support flood hazard exposure, cascading failure and resilience analysis of road networks, and complement OSMnx, catalogued here.
name: FloodNet input data - road networks, elevation and flood inundation for Metro Manila, Cebu and Davao
